automated.summary: PH-5 makes the project's record readable and honest: forge history surfaces the 300+ committed events that had no reader; quickfix windows record every file they touch (closing the audit's 29/29-empty gap); a merged PR is linked by a durable event that survives a bare clone; forge init/adopt stamp an honest record-origin boundary; and the two pre-contract stories are marked, never given a fabricated outcome. Verified by dogfooding on this repo throughout.

functional.summary: Driven as a user against this live repo, not asserted from source. forge history printed the six shipped stories with their outcomes and an explicit 'Unattributed events' section surfacing the spec/signoff/roadmap events that carry no story — the audit's gap made visible. forge pr-link PH-4 <url> linked PH-4 to its real PR #42, and forge history --story PH-4 showed the pr-linked event, so 'which PR shipped this' is answerable from committed data. forge doctor reported zero outcome gaps after the two pre-contract stories were marked. The board's record-boundary render was exercised: with an integer count it reads 'record begins here; N commits precede it', with a null (shallow) count it reads 'record begins here' without a number, and with no marker (this repo, which grew its own record) it correctly shows nothing rather than a false claim.
